decisions.decision: Hoist the offline casing-classifiers core determination logic into a shared location rather than writing a second runtime-only derivation
decisions.why: classifyCasing already operates directly on KeyboardIR - FR-008 single-shared-derivation is achievable structurally via a hoist, not by convention/testing two implementations for agreement
decisions.rejected: A second, simplified runtime-only casing check verified by a parity test against the offline classifier
